page_title: WOL 0-2 ARS | Wolves v Arsenal 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+7' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jose Sa anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
90+6' The attendance for today's match is 31621.
90+5' 0 - 2 Goal! Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 0:2.
90+5' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90+3' The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
90+2' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
87' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
85' The game is interrupted now, Mario Lemina (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
84' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Paul Tierney blows his whistle for an infringement.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Thomas Partey (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Gabriel Jesus.
80' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
79' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
75' Substitution. Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Matt Doherty walks off.
75' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Tawanda Chirewa will be replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
74' Matt Doherty (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Wolves earn a corner.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) for Leandro Trossard.
72' The linesman raises his flag. Ben White (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
71' A great solo run by Mario Lemina (Wolves) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the top of the net was easily caught by David Raya.
70' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
69' Joao Gomes (Wolves) jumps into a tackle and Paul Tierney signals a foul. Arsenal are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
65' A pass by Ben White (Arsenal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
62' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
62' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
61' Paul Tierney blows his whistle. Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a foul after dangerous play.
61' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Mario Lemina (Wolves) was too aggressive in his challenge. Arsenal will take a free kick.
58' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is caught offside!
58' Poor challenge! Boubacar Traore (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Paul Tierney blows his whistle.

56' What a wasted opportunity by Kai Havertz (Arsenal)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Jose Sa makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
56' Declan Rice (Arsenal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
55' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Paul Tierney signals a foul. It's a free kick to Arsenal in a dangerous position.
53' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
53' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes it short.

53' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Mario Lemina (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hee-Chan Hwang.
51' The referee gives a yellow card to Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
50' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Ben White (Arsenal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' 0 - 1 Great team effort! Gabriel Jesus is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the inside of the right post to make the score 0:1.
44' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
44' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
43' Paul Tierney blows the whistle, Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul.
39' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
38' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
38' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
36' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Max Kilman (Wolves) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
35' Today's referee Paul Tierney rightly decides to book Declan Rice (Arsenal) for his harsh tackle.
35' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' The free kick is delivered by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
33' Paul Tierney shows the yellow card to Toti (Wolves) for a heavy challenge.

30' A wonderful opportunity! Joao Gomes (Wolves) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the top right corner. However, David Raya makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the post.
30' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
29' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Paul Tierney ignores the protests.
28' William Saliba (Arsenal) attempts to find Ben White, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.

28' A lofted cross from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is behind the touchline and Arsenal will take a throw-in.
26' The ball is cleared after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) inside the box.
24' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where David Raya easily catches the ball.
20' Declan Rice (Arsenal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
18' Paul Tierney has a clear sight and sees a foul from Toti (Wolves).
16' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
15' Declan Rice (Arsenal) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Jose Sa.

14' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.
13' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
10' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Jose Sa makes a comfortable save.

9' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball has crossed the sideline. Arsenal are taking a throw-in.
6' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.

5' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
2' The ball is crossed into the box and Kai Havertz (Arsenal) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa gets a glove on it to thwart him.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Paul Tierney.
